thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: SEV-2 detected - inference-prod cluster us-west-2-infer-03. Symptoms: rapid KV cache growth + continuous-batching regressions causing p95 latency spikes and 5xx errors. Models implicated: llama-7b-mqa, qwen-14b-gqa (GQA edge), some Mistral shards sporadic. Incident ID INC-20260315-4623. Auto-escalating to #eng-oncall and #eng-runtime. @samira @cheng

samira: ack. I'm watching graphs now. pulling up per-model kv metrics.

cheng: oncall here, acked. looking at heap & evictions. initial look: kv_entries_total on llama-7b-mqa jumped from ~120k -> 1.2M in ~8m. continuous_batcher queues are backing up, latency climbing.

liam: curious — any recent rollout for llama or qwen?

cheng: no model code rollouts in the last 24h. config drift: a autoscale policy tweak rolled yesterday, but not sure it's related.

elaine: support reports 2 enterprise customers seeing timeouts in the last 10m, tickets incoming. @support-june can you confirm?

support-june: confirming. customer A: multiple requests in a short burst timed out; logs show 502 from the inference gateway with "kv-cache-miss-exhausted" in backend. Customer B seeing 504s on streaming. Both affected by llama-7b-mqa & qwen-14b-gqa routes.

cheng: hypothesis: continuous batching + GQA/MQA interaction caused excessive KV cache key fanout (tokenization differences + streaming chunker creating unique prefixes). eviction policy fell behind and memory pressure triggered transient errors. Need quick mitigation before deep RCA.

samira: Agreed. mitigation checklist (fast):
- disable continuous batching for affected model(s)
- reduce batch_max_tokens / max_batch_size for affected pools
- tighten kv_cache.max_entries or lower TTL for new keys
- route traffic to fallback model variant (int8 or non-MQA) for high qps customers
Can we apply per-model config override?

cheng: yes. I can push a per-model override. Doing it for llama-7b-mqa first, then qwen-14b-gqa. Backoff if anything breaks.

cheng: applying override now. command:```bash
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal.redwood/api/v1/overrides" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"selector":"model:llama-7b-mqa","patch":{"continuous_batching":{"enabled":false},"batching":{"max_batch_tokens":512,"max_batch_size":8},"kv_cache":{"max_entries":50000}}}'
```

ops-automation-bot: Received request. Starting config patch job (job id job-98432). Will apply to pool us-west-2-infer-03 in sequence.

ops-automation-bot: PATCH applied to llama-7b-mqa on us-west-2-infer-03 (commit: f3a9b2e). PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infra/overrides/pulls/672.

cheng: rolling the same changes to qwen-14b-gqa now (lower batch tokens, disable continuous batching).

ops-automation-bot: PATCH applied to qwen-14b-gqa (commit: f3a9b2e). Starting soft-restart of affected workers (graceful).

samira: monitoring. initial numbers: errors from 18% -> 9% within 90s of first patch. p95 latency trending down from 1.8s -> 1.05s.

support-june: customer A reports partial recovery, many requests succeed now. still seeing occasional retries needed.

cheng: checking logs. observed log snippet:```
[2026-03-15T15:13:07Z] inference: model=llama-7b-mqa req_id=ae3f2 kv_keys_added=8423 kv_total=1012320 continuous_batch_len=64
[2026-03-15T15:13:08Z] inference: model=llama-7b-mqa req_id=ae3f3 error=kv-local-alloc-failed status=502
```
Root cause likely many unique kv keys per request due to streaming chunker adding request-specific nonce to prefix (GQA/MQA tokenization).

liam: is there an immediate fix to the chunker/keying logic? hard to patch and rollout quickly. prefer config hotfix then code fix in next few days.

elaine: talk to runtime team to add per-request normalization to key generation in a follow-up. add to postmortem action items.

cheng: I'm going to also temporarily increase eviction cadence for that pool to free memory quicker. kicking that now. command:```bash
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal.redwood/api/v1/pools/us-west-2-infer-03/eviction" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"interval_ms":5000}'
```

ops-automation-bot: eviction cadence set to 5000ms for us-west-2-infer-03 (applied).

samira: after eviction change + disabling continuous batching, 5xx down to 3.7%, p95 ~0.95s stable for 5m. Good.

support-june: escalating to affected customer stakeholders with mitigation update and ETA for full fix.

cheng: preparing a short handoff — I'm going to step off on-call in 25m. tl;dr:
- mitigation applied: continuous_batching disabled for llama-7b-mqa & qwen-14b-gqa + reduced batch sizes + faster eviction
- observed improvement, but watch for regression when we re-enable batching or revert eviction cadence
- follow-ups: code fix for kv key normalization, add per-model safeguards (max_new_keys_per_minute), extend metrics (kv_key_fanout by token_prefix)
- links: runbook: https://runbook.redwood.ai/kv-cache-fanout, PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infra/overrides/pulls/672, dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/kv/kv-fanout?orgId=1

cheng: handing to liam for overnight monitoring and full RCA. please ack and note SLA impact to customers A & B.

liam: ack. I'll watch the us-west pool for 3h. set alert thresholds for kv_entries_total > 300k and continuous_batch_queue > 20. adding that now.

oncall-bot: Alert rule added: kv_entries_total (>300000) on us-west-2-infer-03 -> page #eng-oncall.

liam: also I'll prepare a limited canary to test a safer batching config (enable continuous batching but with max_new_keys_per_minute=50 and key_normalization=true) in staging tomorrow. will share schedule.

elaine: adding postmortem owners: cheng (lead), liam (monitor & remediation), runtime eng (code fix). Expect postmortem draft in 3 working days.

support-june: closing immediate tickets? waiting for final confirm from customers that full routing restored. will update later.

samira: thanks team. major win on fast mitigation. We'll reconvene after RCA.

liam: handing to oncall rotation. I'll drop a short summary in #incidents once passed 1h stable.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-4623: mitigation applied, customer impact reduced. Monitoring period started.

cheng: leaving notes in the incident doc and runbook. signing off from thread.

liam: thanks — taking over.
